description: An asset's master URL is unmarked in the spec, which only says it is "the temporary URL to the master version of the video" that "will expire after 24 hours" (https://www.mux.com/api-spec.json, component Asset.master). It is a signed download link: anyone holding it can download the full-quality master MP4 until it expires. A live `getAsset` on a test asset with `master_access: "temporary"` on 2026-11-25 returned `master.url` as `https://mezzanine.mux.com/{id}/master.mp4?skid=...&signature=...`.
